evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim in native pipeline vocabulary — domain jargon (rollback, rehearsed) wielded with rhetorical parallelism to crystallize a rule; the document's register signature.
